__prompts__.python_version: Select Python version. Provide only major.minor, e.g., 3.13, 3.12, 3.11 - no patch version)
__prompts__.linter_rules_core: Enable core linting rules? (Essential Python style and error detection: pycodestyle, Pyflakes, pep8-naming, pylint)
__prompts__.linter_rules_imports: Enable import linting rules? (Import organization: isort)
__prompts__.linter_rules_typing: Enable typing linting rules? (Type annotation enforcement: flake8-annotations)
__prompts__.linter_rules_modernization: Enable modernization linting rules? (Code modernization: pyupgrade, flake8-use-pathlib)
__prompts__.linter_rules_testing: Enable testing linting rules? (Testing best practices: flake8-pytest)
__prompts__.linter_rules_cleanup: Enable cleanup linting rules? (Remove dead code and debug statements: eradicate, flake8-print)
__prompts__.linter_rules_practices: Enable best practices linting rules? (Code quality: flake8-return, flake8-async, flake8-datetimez)
__prompts__.use_ty: Include ty for type checking? (Type checker: ty)
__prompts__.include_codeowners: Include CODEOWNERS? (Creates an empty `.github/CODEOWNERS` file for you to fill in)
__prompts__.include_contributing_md: Include CONTRIBUTING.md? (Contributor workflow, PR title and release guidance)
__prompts__.include_docs: Include documentation setup? (MkDocs config, docs pages, docs workflow)
__prompts__.include_code_quality_checks: Include code quality checks workflow? (GitHub Actions workflow for Ruff, pytest, and ty when enabled)
__prompts__.include_pr_title_checks: Require conventional commit titles in PRs? (GitHub Actions PR title validation via .github/versionrc)
__prompts__.include_release_workflow: Include release workflow? (GitHub Actions + semantic-release + PyPI trusted publishing)
